title: EUI-64 (64-bit identifier)
summary: EUI-64 is a 64-bit identifier used in IPv6 (interface ID), FireWire, and Zigbee. Derived from EUI-48 by inserting 0xFFFE in the middle: XX:XX:XX:FF:FE:XX:XX:XX. The U/L bit (bit 1 of byte 0) is flipped when used as an IPv6 interface ID.

notes: Derived from EUI-48: insert 0xFFFE in the middle (after 3 bytes).
Used in IPv6 interface IDs (with U/L bit flipped).
Used in FireWire (IEEE 1394), Zigbee, and other protocols.
EUI-64 is not globally unique in practice (privacy concerns led to randomized interface IDs).
